title: Salvation
author: Baijnath Gupta
text:
Salvation!
Who wants it?

Me?
Certainly not.

Let me live like a Prince
And die like a phoenix
To return to life again
From my own ashes.

And move around the lamp
Like a moth,

And live or vanish
As the lamp burns or dies

In a never-ending cycle
Until the moth and the lamp
Die together
On doomsday.

Till then
Let me come and go and come
And go and come

Like a moth circling around the lamp.
stanzas: Let me live like a Prince
As the lamp burns or dies
Until the moth and the lamp
Let me come and go and come
Like a moth circling around the lamp.
